hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "try { $p = Join-Path (Get-Location) '.ai-safety\hooks\windows\guard-prompt.ps1'; if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { throw ('AI Safety hook missing: ' + $p) }; & $p; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine($_.Exception.Message); exit 2 }"
